method: max-over-5 MP selection per c-class PUT, permute MP labels within PUT
interpretation: permutation_p_value_one_sided_geq quantifies how often the max-over-5 rule (used in §3.5.1) achieves a c-class aligned mean SMS at least as large as observed when MP labels are exchangeable within each c-class PUT. Bonferroni-effective alpha is the conservative bound when no permutation is run. Both are sensitivity analyses for the c-class primary MP shift's selection-on-response inflation.
